title: Context7 supplies current documentation to coding agents
friendlyTitle: Give coding agents newer software documentation
summary: Context7 is an MCP-based service and source repository that gives coding assistants current, version-specific library documentation and examples. The MIT-licensed project has more than 61,000 stars and remains under active development, although some supporting backend components are not included in the public repository.
friendlySummary: Context7 lets compatible AI coding tools fetch current documentation and examples for the library version you use.
whyItMatters: Developers can connect it to compatible coding agents to reduce answers based on stale APIs or invented methods. Because retrieved documentation becomes model context, teams should still review generated code and understand which parts of the service are hosted rather than open source.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to reduce mistakes caused by old or invented API details. People should still review the code, and not every part of the hosted service is open source.
